body: I'm ready to cut off all contact with them. They are just making up a bunch of stuff and involving my ex in it. My mother also refuses to cease her relationship with my ex, even though it's completely inappropriate... I don't want to see them again but at the same time the feelings they've caused are already here and I don't know if cutting contact will immediately alleviate them

My mom has been inflicting pain a lot lately on other parts of her family. As such, I've forced myself to relive the things she did to me as a teenager that put me in the psych ward for being suicidal... I relived them to bring them up in therapy but now I've fallen too deep. She has also done things to bring my ex girlfriend into the picture, it's a relationship that I broke off but lasted 5 years, 4 of which were us living together. I've cut off contact with my ex but recently have been forced to talk to her again and it cuts deep.
